headline: Egypt Targets 6.6 Billion Cubic Feet Daily Gas Production by 2027
summary: Egypt aims to reach an oil and gas production capacity of 6.6 billion cubic feet per day by 2027 through increased drilling, exploration incentives, and international investment.
why: Egypt is a key energy producer in North Africa, and its domestic production capacity directly influences regional supply balances and the operations of international energy majors active in the country.
